name: skills-panel
description: A Claude Code panel for your skills, gates and connectors: Skills, Gates and Connectors tabs, a search, an Active Only filter, and a switch on every row. Point it at a skills library (a folder here, or on a server over ssh) to install skills from it with one click.

libraryFolder.title: Library Folder
libraryFolder.description: The folder holding your skills library, for example ~/skills-library. Leave empty to use the panel without a library.

libraryServer.title: Library Server
libraryServer.description: Only if the library is on another computer: the ssh host to reach it (a host name or an alias from your ssh config). Leave empty for a folder on this computer.

skillsFolder.title: Skills Folder
skillsFolder.description: The folder inside the library that holds skills, one folder per skill with a SKILL.md.

gatesFolder.title: Gates Folder
gatesFolder.description: The folder inside the library that holds gates (checking skills). Leave empty if your gates live with your skills, tagged skill-type/gate.
